For the Major - I can't take DS 400 Capstone without DS 310, which in turn i cannot take without MATH 215. It is not worth taking all 3 for my major as it does not leave me with enough credits for my minor and elective. Hence, the only logical choice is DS 210 and DS 220, which provides a good combination between an introductory course and a slightly challenging course for my major.   For the Minor - Since I am minoring in Global Studies, INTL 220 and INTL 250 make a good pair, striking the right balance between an introductory course and a strong course for my minor. INTL 250 and LANG 202 have overlaps, so there is no point in taking them together. Choosing INTL 250 over INTL 301 was a tactical decision, as Comparative Politics makes more sense than International Economic Policy (keeping in mind my Minor which is Global Studies)  For the Elective - I only require one elective course to meet the minimum criteria, and ECON 105 is a good choice as it is a good supplementary course keeping in mind the fact that my major deals with Data Science and my minor deals with Global Studies.
